help.title: HELP
help.context.menu: Reference overlay over the main menu.
help.controls.title: CONTROLS
help.bricks.title: BRICK TYPES
help.bricks.standard.title: Standard
help.bricks.standard.description: Basic target brick. Clears in one hit.
help.bricks.tough.title: Tough
help.bricks.tough.description: Usually used to increase density or guide rebounds.
help.bricks.combo.title: Combo
help.bricks.combo.description: Supports score chains and more dangerous angles.
help.bricks.heavy.title: Heavy
help.bricks.heavy.description: Highlights priority targets and lane blockers.
help.bricks.explosive.title: Explosive
help.bricks.explosive.description: Detonates when destroyed, damages up to three nearest bricks inside a 160 px blast radius, and plays a dedicated explosion effect.
help.bricks.indestructible: Indestructible bricks reflect the ball and must be routed around.
help.bricks.shielded: Shielded variants appear later and raise routing priority.
help.bonuses.title: BONUSES
help.bonuses.positive.title: POSITIVE POWERUPS
help.bonuses.negative.title: NEGATIVE PENALTIES
help.bonuses.special.title: SPECIAL BONUSES
help.bonuses.bonus_score.title: +1000 Points
help.bonuses.bonus_score.description: Adds +1000 points to the current score.
help.bonuses.bonus_score_200.title: +200 Points
help.bonuses.bonus_score_200.description: Adds +200 points to the current score.
help.bonuses.bonus_score_500.title: +500 Points
help.bonuses.bonus_score_500.description: Adds +500 points to the current score.
help.bonuses.extra_life.title: Extra Life
help.bonuses.extra_life.description: Adds one extra life to the player.
help.bonuses.bonus_ball.title: Extra Ball
help.bonuses.bonus_ball.description: Spawns an extra ball on the field above the paddle.
help.bonuses.level_pass.title: Level Pass
help.bonuses.level_pass.description: Instantly completes the current level with victory.
help.bonuses.call_ball.title: Call Ball
help.bonuses.call_ball.description: Attracts balls to the paddle when pressing B key.
help.bonuses.slow_balls.title: Slow Balls
help.bonuses.slow_balls.description: Slows down the speed of all balls on the field by 30%.
help.bonuses.fast_balls.title: Fast Balls
help.bonuses.fast_balls.description: Increases the speed of all balls on the field by 50%.
help.bonuses.score_rain.title: Score Rain
help.bonuses.score_rain.description: Grants +1000 bonus points for every destroyed block.
help.bonuses.weak_balls.title: Weak Balls
help.bonuses.weak_balls.description: Balls deal minimal damage to bricks and bosses.
help.bonuses.energy_balls.title: Energy Balls
help.bonuses.energy_balls.description: Balls pass through any bricks without bouncing.
help.bonuses.explosion_balls.title: Explosive Balls
help.bonuses.explosion_balls.description: Creates an explosion on block contact, destroying adjacent blocks.
help.bonuses.increase_paddle.title: Increase Paddle
help.bonuses.increase_paddle.description: Increases the width of the paddle (stacks up to 6 times).
help.bonuses.decrease_paddle.title: Decrease Paddle
help.bonuses.decrease_paddle.description: Decreases the width of the paddle.
help.bonuses.sticky_paddle.title: Sticky Paddle
help.bonuses.sticky_paddle.description: Paddle catches balls, launch with LMB or Space.
help.bonuses.plasma_weapon.title: Plasma Weapon
help.bonuses.plasma_weapon.description: Laser weapon to shoot at bricks (keys Z, X, C).
help.bonuses.frozen_paddle.title: Frozen Paddle
help.bonuses.frozen_paddle.description: Fully freezes and blocks the paddle movement.
help.bonuses.invisible_paddle.title: Invisible Paddle
help.bonuses.invisible_paddle.descriptio: Makes the paddle completely invisible to the player.
help.bonuses.bonus_wall.title: Safety Wall
help.bonuses.bonus_wall.description: Creates a safety barrier at the bottom of the field.
help.bonuses.darkness.title: Darkness
help.bonuses.darkness.description: Darkens the screen, making walls and bricks invisible.
help.bonuses.chaotic_balls.title: Chaotic Balls
help.bonuses.chaotic_balls.description: Balls start moving in unpredictable trajectories.
help.bonuses.bonus_magnet.title: Bonus Magnet
help.bonuses.bonus_magnet.description: Attracts all positive powerup capsules to the paddle.
help.bonuses.penalties_magnet.title: Penalty Magnet
help.bonuses.penalties_magnet.descriptio: Attracts all negative penalty capsules to the paddle.
help.bonuses.bad_luck.title: Bad Luck
help.bonuses.bad_luck.description: Removes all powerups and activates all penalties with double duration.
help.bonuses.trickster.title: Trickster
help.bonuses.trickster.description: Removes all penalties and activates all powerups with double duration.
help.bonuses.rainbow_bounty.title: Rainbow Bounty
help.bonuses.rainbow_bounty.description: For 15 seconds, every destroyed brick drops a positive bonus.
help.bonuses.blood_tithe.title: Blood Tithe
help.bonuses.blood_tithe.description: For 15 seconds, every destroyed brick drops a negative bonus.
help.bonuses.add_five_seconds.title: +5 Seconds
help.bonuses.add_five_seconds.descriptio: Extends the duration of all active bonuses by +5 seconds.
help.bonuses.reset.title: Reset
help.bonuses.reset.description: Resets all active powerups and penalties to standard values.
help.bonuses.random_bonus.title: Random Bonus
help.bonuses.random_bonus.description: Activates a random bonus from the list of enabled ones.
help.bonuses.footer: Bonus icons are shown directly from sprite atlas.
help.goal.title: GAME GOAL
help.goal.paragraph1: Break every required brick, keep at least one ball alive, and control rebounds so the paddle stays ahead of the angle.
help.goal.paragraph2: Use paddle positioning, launch timing, and bonuses to stabilize dangerous patterns before they cost a life.
help.goal.return_menu: Back returns to the main menu overlay layer.
help.goal.return_pause: Back returns to pause without losing current run.
settings.title: SETTINGS
settings.status.defaults_staged: Defaults staged. Press Apply to save or Back to choose.
settings.status.key_assigned: Key assigned. Press Apply to save.
settings.status.no_settings_path: Settings applied, but no settings file path is configured.
settings.validation.player_name_empty: Player name must not be empty.
settings.validation.paddle_speed_range: Paddle speed must be between 200 and 2000.
settings.validation.turbo_speed_range: Turbo speed must be between 400 and 12000.
settings.validation.move_keys_different: Move left and move right must use different keys.
settings.validation.launch_pause_differe: Launch and pause must use different keys.
settings.validation.duplicate_keys: Each action must use a different key.
settings.validation.reserved_keys: F1-F4 and F11 are reserved debug keys.

settings.controls.capture_prompt: Press a key, or Escape to cancel.
